verdict.rationale: Docs clearly show charges can be split between platform and connected accounts as first-class API objects (docs-6, docs-7), with balances and payouts manageable per account (docs-18, docs-13). However, the evidence pack lacks explicit documentation of reversing or adjusting a split after the fact (e.g., reversing transfers or partial refunds tied to application fees), only touching disputes generally (docs-17). missing for 10: explicit reversal/adjustment API documentation, independent hands-on confirmation of split modification.
